sections.name: File setup, savePreferences, loadPreferences, saveLanguage
sections.title: Save and load preferences
sections.what: Saves sports and language together, loads them, or saves only the language.
sections.why: Separate functions let the language switch change the language without touching sports.
sections.watch_out: Saving sports replaces the whole list, so a partial list from a caller removes the rest.

summary: Reads and saves a user's favourite sports and language in the database.
purpose: Keeps the database calls for preferences in one place.
why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely reason: separating database work from the rules.
how: Each function updates or reads a user record and selects only the preference fields.
inputs: A user id, a list of sports, and a language code.
outputs: The saved or loaded preference fields.
risks: There is no check that the user exists, so an unknown id makes the update fail. The language is not checked here.
debug: If preferences do not save, check the user id and the database connection.
